home.tagline: Leader in high-end garment manufacturing with unmatched Moroccan expertise
home.aboutTitle: A Success Story Made in Morocco
home.aboutDescription: Founded in 2021 in Casablanca Ain Sebaa by Moubarak Amqor, Texam Confection has quickly established itself as a key player in the ready-to-wear industry. Our rapid growth, with over 1,500 satisfied clients per year, demonstrates our expertise and ability to meet the demands of major brands.
home.servicesSubtitle: Complete solutions for your garment manufacturing needs
home.service1Description: Expert tailoring and manufacturing of high-end garments with meticulous attention to detail
home.service2Description: Rigorous quality assurance at every step of the manufacturing process
home.service3Description: Efficient production cycles without compromising quality
home.qualityDescription: At Texam, quality isn't just a promise – it's our foundation. Our modern workshop combines traditional Moroccan craftsmanship with contemporary manufacturing excellence.
home.ctaDescription: Join the leading brands who trust Texam Atelier for their high-end manufacturing needs
